description: Every class under src that directly owns a method named commit must also directly own a method named rollback. Classes without their own commit are outside the obligation; inherited, nested, module-level, or other-class rollback declarations do not satisfy it. This checks source declarations, not runtime transaction behavior.

examples.name: pass: directly owned commit and rollback
pass: classes without their own commit have no obligation
fail: own commit missing own rollback
fail: a good class must not hide a bad class
fail: rollback on another class cannot satisfy the requirement
fail: same class name in another file is a different owner
fail: module-level rollback is a lookalike
fail: rollback nested in a method is not directly owned
fail: rollback on a nested class is not the outer class method
fail: inherited rollback does not satisfy direct ownership
pass: inherited commit does not impose a direct ownership obligation
pass: commit-only class outside src is outside the domain
